_note: Fees taken from the public price list described in CLAUDE.md sections 6.5 and 6.6, rewritten as structured data. NHS charges are the England bands from 1 April 2026. eligibility_rule is enforced in policies.py, never by the LLM. is_bookable = false means Sophia can quote the fee but cannot book it directly, the team confirms after assessment.

appointment_types.name: NHS examination and diagnosis
appointment_types.description: Examination, diagnosis including X-rays if needed, prevention advice, a scale if clinically needed.

appointment_types.name: NHS Band 2 treatment
appointment_types.description: Everything in Band 1 plus fillings, root canal treatment or extractions.

appointment_types.name: NHS Band 3 treatment
appointment_types.description: Everything in Bands 1 and 2 plus crowns, dentures, bridges and other lab work.

appointment_types.name: NHS urgent appointment
appointment_types.description: Deals with the immediate problem, for example pain relief or a temporary filling. Permanent treatment may need a separate appointment.

appointment_types.name: New patient examination
appointment_types.description: For patients new to the practice, or not seen for at least three years. Includes radiographs if required. Payable on booking.

appointment_types.name: Routine examination
appointment_types.description: For patients seen regularly who have already had a new patient consultation. Includes radiographs if required.

appointment_types.name: Review appointment
appointment_types.description: A review with a dentist or dental therapist, for example a gum review. No radiographs.

appointment_types.name: Emergency consultation, new patient
appointment_types.description: For patients who have never visited, or who have not had a routine or new patient examination in three years.

appointment_types.name: Emergency consultation, existing patient
appointment_types.description: For patients seen for routine treatment within the last three years.

appointment_types.name: Hygiene appointment, up to 20 minutes
appointment_types.description: With a dental hygiene therapist.

appointment_types.name: Hygiene appointment, up to 30 minutes
appointment_types.description: With a dental hygiene therapist.

appointment_types.name: Hygiene appointment, up to 40 minutes
appointment_types.description: With a dental hygiene therapist.

appointment_types.name: Hygiene appointment, up to 60 minutes
appointment_types.description: For extensive gum disease or heavy staining.

appointment_types.name: Hygienist direct access
appointment_types.description: See a hygiene therapist without seeing a dentist first. For patients not seen before, or not seen for at least three years.

appointment_types.name: Root canal consultation with special interest dentist
appointment_types.description: Assessment before private root canal treatment.

appointment_types.name: Root canal, incisor or canine, special interest dentist
appointment_types.description: Price starts from this figure. Confirmed after consultation.

appointment_types.name: Root canal, premolar, special interest dentist
appointment_types.description: Price starts from this figure. Confirmed after consultation.

appointment_types.name: Root canal, molar, special interest dentist
appointment_types.description: Price starts from this figure. Confirmed after consultation.

appointment_types.name: Root canal, incisor or canine, general dentist
appointment_types.description: Excludes the fee for the filling or crown that restores the tooth afterwards.

appointment_types.name: Routine extraction
appointment_types.description: Charged in addition to the assessment fee.

appointment_types.name: Surgical extraction
appointment_types.description: Price starts from this figure. Charged in addition to the assessment fee.

appointment_types.name: Emergency post extraction dressing
appointment_types.description: For a painful socket after an extraction.
